key.name: menu-position
key.summary: Position of the Nepali Calendar Menu
key.description: Allows users to choose where the menu is placed on the panel ('left', 'center', 'right').

key.name: top-bar-format
key.description: Format of the date in the top bar: 'full', 'medium', or 'date-only'.

key.name: show-day-of-week
key.summary: Show day of week in top bar
key.description: Whether to show the day of the week in the top bar indicator.

key.name: show-year
key.description: Whether to show the Nepali year in the top bar indicator.

key.name: show-icon
key.summary: Show calendar icon in top bar
key.description: Whether to show a calendar icon next to the date in the top bar.

key.name: show-english-dates
key.description: Whether to show the Gregorian date in the popup card.

key.name: highlight-holidays
key.description: Whether to highlight public holidays and Saturdays in the popup card.

key.name: show-tithi
key.description: Whether to show the Nepali lunar Tithi in the popup card.

key.name: show-events
key.summary: Show events and festivals in popup
key.description: Whether to show cultural events and festivals in the popup card.
